meta.name: Bizum Usaklar
meta.description: Two fugitives looking for a place to hide become teachers by chance in a village in Araklı. The first task of the fake teachers is to reconcile two cousins living in the same village. To reconcile the cousins, who have been estranged for years due to a border dispute, the villagers and the new teachers devise a plan. The villagers, who plan to bring the two together by claiming there is a buried treasure on their shared land, find themselves facing unforeseen circumstances.
